title: LAirs Enchants
description: This mod adds over 20 enchantements to Minecraft inspired by my subscribers suggestions.
body:
# Extra Enchantments

Minecraft already has more than **40 enchantments**, but what if there were even more?

This mod adds a collection of **brand-new enchantments**, all inspired by ideas suggested by my YouTube subscribers. Some improve existing mechanics, others introduce entirely new gameplay possibilities, making your survival adventure even more fun and dynamic.

---

# ✨ Featured Enchantments

## 🔥 Smelt

The **Smelting** enchantment automatically cooks any block that has a smelted variant as soon as you mine it. Ores, wood, and many other blocks are instantly transformed into their cooked version.

![Smelt Enchantement Minecraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e75e13d7ce67fc10c5aca378bb476603f9efd744.jpeg)

---

## 🪂 Parachute

The **Parachute** enchantment automatically grants you **Slow Falling** when your Elytra runs out of durability, giving you just enough time to land safely instead of crashing.

![Parachute Elytra](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43c01e22814095e9882dbed1bd704d19c2c8529e.jpeg)

---

## 👻 Transparency

Normally, wearing armor completely ruins the effect of invisibility.

With **Transparency**, enchanted armor pieces become invisible whenever you receive the **Invisibility** effect, allowing you to truly disappear.

![Transparency](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40b368a152b058cdc6fb5bc7cc02a1f5a703694a.jpeg)

---

## 📦 Cotton Touch

An upgraded version of **Silk Touch**.

**Cotton Touch** preserves all **block data (NBT)** when breaking blocks, allowing you to move:
- Chests with their contents
- Furnaces with stored items
- Signs with their text
- Mob spawners...

![Coton Touch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a669c11b059ce8b18f0d29319c28d6144ad50319.jpeg)

---

## 💀 Necromancer

This enchantment summons a **Necromancer** that gains power when you kill ennemies using the enchantement. Whenever it takes damage, it consumes those souls to heal itsel.

---

## 🌳 Lumberjack

Instead of instantly breaking every log, the tree **gradually collapses downward**, creating a more natural animation while still saving you plenty of time.

![Lumberjack Minecraft enchantement](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3fe6725fb28e4db5c79c839eb03e095b7bcb9845.jpeg)

---

## 💚 Super Mending

Rather than waiting for XP orbs, this enchantment repairs your equipment by directly consuming experience from your **XP bar** whenever needed. It activates when you hold the item in your secondary hand.

---

## 🤦 Clumsy

With **Clumsy**, every missed attack has a chance to make you **drop the item you're holding**.

---

## ⚔️ Combo

Each consecutive hit increases your weapon's **attack speed**, spam clicking is back I guess...


---

## 🌪️ Tornado

When applied to a **Trident**, every thrown trident creates a massive **tornado** where it lands, pulling nearby mobs into the air and dealing them damage.

---

## ❤️ Love

The **Love** enchantment lets you:
- Instantly tame animals.
- Heal mobs.
- Breed nearby animals.

---

## 🔍 Convection

The first enchantment made for the **Spyglass**.
Focus sunlight through the lens to **ignite distant mobs**, just like using a magnifying glass.


---

## 🛡️ Lightness

While holding your shield, your speed is increased.

---

## 📍 Air Tag

If you die while carrying equipment enchanted with **Air Tag**, your dropped items are indicated on a treasure map.

![LAirTag Enchantements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/388a4d4c10179bebda18280877d8d088bae1b42c.jpeg)

---

## 🦘 Double Jump

Exactly what it sounds like. 

---

## 🏹 Homing

Arrows fired from a weapon enchanted with **Homing** automatically adjust their trajectory to chase nearby targets. A higher level of enchantement increases the precision.


---

## 🩸 Leech

Every successful hit restores a portion of the damage dealt as health, higher level means more life stolen.

---

## 🌋 Lava Walker

Basically Frost Walk on lava. Don't go too fast tough...

![Lava Walker Minecraft Enchantement](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c83e69ce89d1b74985e9e87413cd36666520ba3b.jpeg)

---

## 🖐️ Reach

The **Reach** enchantment increases your mining distance, making large builds and resource gathering much more convenient. You gain 0,5 blocks per level of enchantement.

---
